name: JC Biomedical - Medical Equipment Repair & Calibration
old_description: JC Biomedical is a privately owned comprehensive biomedical equipment service company. We have been providing our services to medical facilities and health care systems in Omaha and the surrounding area since 1997.
about:
JC Biomedical was founded in 1997 in Omaha, Nebraska, as a privately owned biomedical equipment service company. The business began serving medical facilities and health care systems in the Omaha area and has since expanded its reach across the Midwest.

The company provides a full range of biomedical equipment services, including preventive maintenance, electrical safety inspections, equipment calibrations, repairs, pre-use inspections, equipment inventory management, and equipment sales. Its nationally certified technicians work on a wide variety of clinical devices, with specialization in cardiology, surgical, anesthesia, and general biomedical equipment. Services are performed on-site at hospitals, surgical centers, clinics, laboratories, and veterinary facilities.

JC Biomedical serves a diverse client base across the healthcare sector. Customers include large and small hospitals, outpatient surgery centers, medical clinics, research facilities, laboratories, and veterinarians. Long-term clients such as Miracle Hills Surgery Center and various outpatient surgery managers have relied on the company for over two decades for prompt repairs, detailed preventive maintenance programs, and regulatory compliance documentation.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, local responsiveness, and technician expertise as its core differentiators. Its mission is to deliver timely repairs and calibrations at the most competitive prices in the Midwest, while helping clients eliminate costly manufacturer service contracts. Technicians also provide staff training on proper equipment operation and maintenance to increase patient safety and equipment longevity.
